name: browser_use_cloud
description: Run an opt-in hosted Browser Use Cloud V4 browser agent. Web text chat only; requires BROWSER_USE_API_KEY, the background worker, and selection in Settings → Tools → Background tasks. Returns a receipt immediately, a live browser link while working, and a saved research report later. The hosted browser uses Browser Use's own model and network, not Jarvis's selected LLM or local Browser Use container. Runs anonymously for public research. Set use_profile true when the user requests their saved profile OR an action that requires their signed-in account, such as sending an email; do not require the user to say 'profile'. The profile may have existing login sessions, but neither Jarvis nor a recipient address establishes which account is signed in. Do not buy anything or change an account unless the user directly requests that action.

availability.setup_hint: Add BROWSER_USE_API_KEY to the active cloud.env or local.env, then enable Browser Use Cloud in Web Settings → Tools → Background tasks.

task.description: Browser goal, including what to verify and report. For a saved-profile action, tell the agent to use the existing signed-in session if available and report a login challenge if not. Never assert a sender/account identity inferred from a recipient or destination. For email, put the requested address only in the To field unless the user separately named a required sender; specify subject/body, send only when requested, and verify the result.

use_profile.description: Use the server-configured saved Browser Use Cloud login profile for this run. Set true when the user requests their profile or an action requiring their signed-in account, such as sending an email, even if they do not say 'profile'. Omit or set false for anonymous public browsing. Existing cookies may provide a login; the agent must inspect the site rather than assume which account is active. The profile ID is never supplied by the model.
